_comment: noirblaze -- GENERATED by build/emit from palette.toml. Do not edit this file;
edit palette.toml in the noirblaze repo and re-run build/emit.
Profile 'aa': WCAG 2.2 AA: 4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for non-text
The ramp is solved against a composited background of T = 36 -- the theme's own
#121212 as seen through a terminal at the recommended opacity over a backdrop
of 153 (median brightest window-sized tile, 41 ultrawide wallpapers, 2026-09-05).
The colours are correct at ANY opacity: T is a property of the palette, not of
the wallpaper, so only the opacity is adaptive. bin/noct-glass in the dots repo
computes it; dist/glass.conf.sample carries the static recommendation.
Dark only, matching the source. Noctalia falls back to the dark variant when
mode = light, so nothing breaks -- it just stays dark.
ATTRIBUTION
The 22-slot terminal block is upstream's, bar two values:
n1ghtmare/noirblaze-kitty, MIT, (c) 2023 Dimitar Dimitrov
n1ghtmare/noirblaze-vim, MIT, (c) 2025 Dimitar Dimitrov
'green' (#00ff77) and 'green_bright' (#2eff8f) are NOT upstream's -- upstream
sets ANSI 2 and ANSI 10 to pink. They are what make 'git diff' and 'ls'
readable, and the solver is forbidden from touching them.
New work MIT, (c) 2026 Torben Kopplin.
Selected from the launcher with /theme, or:
noctalia msg color-scheme-set custom noirblaze
